description: This file contains the implementation of SparkRackResolver, a utility class for resolving network rack locations for hosts in a Hadoop YARN environment, including caching and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: SparkRackResolver
classes.description: A class for resolving network topology (rack information) for hosts, with support for configuration-based resolution and caching.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a single hostname to its network location (rack).

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a list of hostnames to their network locations (racks).

methods.name: coreResolve
methods.description: Internal method that performs the actual resolution of hostnames to rack nodes, with fallback to default rack.
